title: The Last Colony Broadcast
description: You intercept a distress broadcast from the last human colony — and recognize your own voice asking for help. The colony was abandoned fifty years ago. A branching space opera AI adventure.

n1.caption: At the edge of mapped space, your freighter catches a distress broadcast from the last human colony — abandoned fifty years ago. Then the speaker says your name in your own voice: 'If you can hear this, do not let them find me.'

n2a.caption: The channel opens on a woman in a cracked helmet. Her face is yours, older by decades. Behind her, the colony glows beneath an impossible red aurora: 'You have eleven minutes before the fleet arrives.'

n2b.caption: You mute the transmission, but it begins playing through the ship's navigation system. A route appears to a star that does not exist on any chart — and the autopilot has already accepted it.

choices.label: Wipe the route and jump away

n3a.caption: 'The fleet is not coming for us,' your older self says. 'It is coming to make sure the colony stays dead.' Behind her, thousands of lights wake beneath the surface — an army that has been waiting for your return.

n3b.caption: The moment you transmit, the older version of you smiles with relief. Then every screen on your bridge displays the same message: COORDINATES RECEIVED. The colony was never calling you. It was baiting the fleet toward you.

n3c.caption: The hidden route folds space around your ship. You emerge inside the colony's shield and find streets preserved exactly as they were fifty years ago — except every shop window displays a live image of your arrival.

n3d.caption: You burn the route and make the jump. For one quiet second, the stars return. Then your ship's speakers whisper in your own voice: 'That was the version where you left us behind.'
